enrichments.summary: Waterfront Bistro Frozen Raw EZ-Peel White Shrimp 21/25, sold at various retailers, is being recalled due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).
AquaStar is recalling its Raw Peeled Tail-on Shrimp Skewers due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).
Kroger Mercado is recalling its Cooked Medium Peeled Tail-Off Shrimp due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137). The product is packaged in 2lb clear plastic bags with UPC 011110626196.
AquaStar is recalling its 13/15 Raw Shrimp Easy Peel Deveined, 2 lbs. packages (UPC 731149654051), sold at Publix, due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).

AquaStar is recalling its 4oz. Cocktail Shrimp due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137). The product was distributed by Aqua Star, Seattle, WA, and sold at Walmart as a refrigerated product.
AquaStar has recalled its 16/20 Frozen Raw EZ-Peel White Shrimp (net wt. 5 lbs., UPC 731149654075), sold at WinCo, due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).

Publix is recalling Extra Large Shrimp due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137). The recalled product is 'Publix Extra Large Shrimp Easy to Peel Deveined 21/25, net wt. 1.5 lbs. UPC 041415064454'.
Kroger has recalled its Raw Colossal EZ Peel Shrimp due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).
AquaStar Seattle, WA is recalling Frozen AquaStar Breaded Shrimp due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).
Publix is recalling its Large Shrimp Peeled & Deveined Tail On (31/40, 1.5 lbs, UPC 041415067455) due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137). The product was sold at Publix stores.
Frozen Mercado Kroger Cooked Shrimp in 2 lbs. packages (UPC 011110626196) has been recalled due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).
Best Yet Frozen Raw EZ-Peel White Shrimp is being recalled due to potential contamination with Cesium-137 (Cs-137).
